# testdata

These compose files are copied verbatim from
[coollabsio/coolify](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify) (`templates/compose/`),
which is licensed **Apache-2.0**. They are here as fixtures: the converter is
tested against the real thing rather than against files written to make it pass,
because the interesting failures are the conventions a hand-written fixture
would not think to include.

Apache-2.0 permits this and asks for the attribution above. It is compatible
with this repository's AGPL-3.0.

Do not edit them. A fixture edited to suit the code under test stops being
evidence that the code handles the corpus.
